limitations: The image does not show the competitors' consent, rules, or events before and after this instant.

philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The unequal positions captured in this instant foreground how power is experienced through bodily vulnerability and the capacity to cause harm.
alternative_interpretations: The apparent imbalance may last only a fraction of a second and may not represent the match as a whole.
